title: How to Restart Router/Modem
overview: Help a reviewer support the Restart Router/Modem step without changing the workflow automatically.
checklist: Please power off your router and modem (if separate devices). Wait for 30 seconds, then power them back on, starting with the modem, then the router. Wait for all lights to stabilize.
